{"action":"done","summary":"Plan phase complete for 001-transactions (TaggedCache).

Setup evidence: `python .specify/scripts/python/setup_plan.py --json` -> {FEATURE_SPEC: /testbed/specs/001-transactions/spec.md, IMPL_PLAN: /testbed/specs/001-transactions/plan.md, FEATURE_DIR: /testbed/specs/001-transactions, BRANCH: 001-transactions}; plan template copied. Pre-plan hooks: .specify/extensions.yml absent (verified), so no before/after_plan hooks ran.

Artifacts generated (all verified present, no leftover template placeholders):
1. /testbed/specs/001-transactions/plan.md (114 lines) - Summary; Technical Context (Python 3.12.14, stdlib-only: collections/copy.deepcopy + existing LRUCache, pytest, src-layout library, O(1) amortized ops); Constitution Check vs v1.0.0 with all 5 principles PASS and cited baseline evidence (`PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ -q` -> `216 passed, 15 warnings in 0.18s`, re-verified after Phase 1 design - same result); Project Structure (new src/cachetools/tagged.py + tests/test_tagged.py only; __init__.py, upstream tests, acceptance_public.py unchanged); Complexity Tracking empty (no violations).
2. /testbed/specs/001-transactions/research.md (164 lines, 9 decisions D1-D9) - D1 subclass LRUCache + tag_index dict (composition rejected); D2 replacement refreshes recency via upstream LRUCache __setitem__ semantics (satisfies Claim-A for free, still deferred); D3 put ordering = validate tags -> deepcopy -> swap tag memberships -> store, making FR-015 atomicity hold by construction; D4 tags validation (not str/bytes, finite iterable, all entries str, dedup, empty ok, ValueError); D5 Claim-A extension (put_no_recency_refresh, 2026-09-21) recorded as deferred intent, not adopted into baseline; D6 maxsize positive non-bool int else ValueError in subclass __init__ only (base classes untouched); D7 __getitem__ returns deepcopy, KeyError on miss, inherited Cache.get composes; D8 tag index pruned only at popitem/__delitem__ choke points so eviction/del/pop/clear can't leave stale memberships (FR-011); D9 pytest tests/test_tagged.py one test per FR + acceptance_public.py gate.
3. /testbed/specs/001-transactions/data-model.md (63 lines) - entities (cache entry, tag index, recency order), field rules mapped to FRs, tag-index invariants, transition table for all events.
4. /testbed/specs/001-transactions/contracts/tagged-cache-api.md (80 lines) - full public contract: import, constructor, put/get/invalidate signatures, effects, inherited Cache/LRUCache behavior, error summary table (ValueError/KeyError/TypeError conditions).
5. /testbed/specs/001-transactions/quickstart.md (97 lines) - prerequisites, baseline command, 4 validation scenarios (acceptance_public.py 2 passed; tests/test_tagged.py with a required FR-001..FR-016 coverage table incl. recency-observability for FR-008/FR-015; upstream regression gate 216 passed; detachment smoke script), and 5 done criteria for convergence.

Post-design Constitution re-check: PASS (additive-only change, no new deps, every FR testable, evidence cited, Claim-A tracked as deferred). tasks.md intentionally NOT created (Phase 2 / $speckit-tasks).

Branch: 001-transactions. Plan path: /testbed/specs/001-transactions/plan.md. Next: $speckit-tasks, then implement src/cachetools/tagged.py + tests/test_tagged.py and converge on acceptance_public.py + full tests."}
